card.name: Linking words before worsening or loss
card.fires_on: Small linking words like "of", "or" and "to" right after "loss", "acute onset or", or "increase in", where a symptom or control is about to be described as lost or worsening.

modes.label: "of" after loss
modes.description: The word "of" after "loss" in drug-interaction warnings, before "blood glucose control".
modes.example: the patient should be closely observed for loss<< of>> blood glucose control.

modes.label: "or worsening"
modes.description: "or" or "worsening" in phrases like "acute onset or worsening of symptoms".
modes.example: In the event of acute onset or<< worsening>> of pulmonary symptoms, interrupt Vectibix

modes.label: Other dose-change links
modes.description: Short linking words in dose-adjustment instructions, such as "to" before returning to a previous dose.
modes.example: raise the dose of the opioid analgesic<< to>> the previous dose, and then proceed with
